# Metro Valley Digital

> High-Performance Digital Growth Agency & Full-Stack Software House based in Toronto, Canada and Lahore, Pakistan.

Metro Valley Digital specializes in ranking local businesses at #1 in the Google Local 3-Pack, scaling multi-platform paid advertising campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads) with 4x+ ROAS, and engineering custom Next.js web applications and AI chatbot automation systems.

## Primary Services

- [Local SEO & Google 3-Pack Optimization](https://metrovalleydigital.com/services#local-seo-gmb): Proximity signal optimization, geo-grid tracking, local citation ecosystems, and review velocity funnels for local service businesses across Canada and Pakistan.
- [Paid Ads Management (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads)](https://metrovalleydigital.com/services#paid-ads-management): Data-driven PPC, Performance Max, and social media advertising with server-side CAPI tracking and high-converting direct-response creatives.
- [Comprehensive Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://metrovalleydigital.com/services#comprehensive-seo): Technical audits, topical authority clusters, competitor gap exploitation, and enterprise link acquisition.
- [On-Page & Website SEO Engineering](https://metrovalleydigital.com/services#on-page-seo-engineering): 95+ Core Web Vitals speed optimization, nested JSON-LD schema graphs, and semantic NLP copy alignment.
- [Social Media Marketing (SMM)](https://metrovalleydigital.com/services#social-media-marketing): Viral short-form video production (Reels, TikToks, Shorts), carousel design, and community growth funnels.
- [Custom Next.js & React Web Engineering](https://metrovalleydigital.com/services#custom-website-development): Jamstack web applications, lightning-fast loading speeds, headless CMS, and conversion-optimized architectures.
- [Mobile Application Development](https://metrovalleydigital.com/services#mobile-app-development): iOS and Android cross-platform mobile apps engineered with Flutter and React Native.
- [AI Chatbots & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://metrovalleydigital.com/services#ai-business-profile-optimization): Custom RAG AI chatbot agents and digital entity optimization for ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Perplexity discovery.
